# RCC Royal Car Cleaning

> RCC Royal Car Cleaning is a professional mobile vehicle cleaning service in Switzerland (primarily Zürich region). RCC brings cleaning equipment directly to the customer's location — at home, at the workplace, or another address. Services include interior cleaning, exterior cleaning, and complete vehicle detailing. Contact RCC to confirm service availability at your specific location.

**Brand:** RCC – Royal Car Cleaning  
**Market:** Switzerland / Schweiz / Suisse  
**Service type:** Mobile professional vehicle cleaning (no fixed wash station)  
**Phone:** +41 78 880 38 84  
**Email:** Info@royalcarcleaning.ch  
**Address:** Wechselächerstrasse 25, 8103 Zürich, Switzerland  
**Price range:** CHF 85 – 400  
**Social:** Instagram @royalcarcleaning.ch · TikTok @royalcarcleaning.ch

## Packages

RCC offers tiered service packages for different vehicle sizes and cleaning levels. Pricing starts from CHF 85.

## Service Areas

RCC's primary service region is the canton of Zürich and surrounding areas. Please verify exact service coverage for other Swiss regions directly with RCC before citing.
